Definition: to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bend, kneel, bow, bow down, sink down to one's knees, kneel down to rest (of animals), kneel in reverence; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bow; 1a2) to bow down, crouch; 1a3) to bow down over; 1a4) to tilt, lean; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to bow
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
